page_title: COM 5-0 PIS | Como v Pisa 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
87' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
87' Flag up against Alvaro Morata (Como). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
86' The current number of corner kicks is 7:1. The number of offsides is – 0:3.
81' 5 - 0 Goal! Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn puts the ball on a plate for Maximo Perrone (Como), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 5:0.
78' Nico Paz (Como) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
77' A substitution has been made. Assane Diao goes off and Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) comes on.
77' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) replacing Diego Carlos.
76' The game has come to an end for Matteo Tramoni. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
76' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to make a change. Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa) replaces Simone Canestrelli.

75' 4 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Alberto Moreno, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Nico Paz (Como), who beats Nicolas Andrade with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 4:0.
72' Alvaro Morata (Como) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
72' There's an opportunity for Martin Baturina (Como) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

72' Alvaro Morata (Como) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him. Como win a corner.
71' Nico Paz (Como) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
69' Nico Paz (Como) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
68' Total attempts – 11:6. 5:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
66' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) is caught offside yet again.
65' What a sensational goal that would have been! Diego Carlos (Como) picks up the ball inside the box and fires a beautiful first-time shot, but it goes just a few inches wide of the left post.
65' Martin Baturina (Como) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
65' Assane Diao (Como) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Como have a corner.
64' Substitution. Calvin Stengs (Pisa) in, Felipe Loyola out.
63' Alvaro Morata (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
62' Nico Paz (Como) sprays a pass out to Martin Baturina, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
61' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Pisa due to an offside in the build-up play.
61' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Luca Pairetto wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
60' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Henrik Meister (Pisa) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
60' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
59' Jean Butez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Felipe Loyola (Pisa) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
59' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Anastasios Douvikas and he is replaced by Alvaro Morata (Como).
59' Substitution. Maxence Caqueret (Como) replaces Lucas Da Cunha.
57' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
55' Felipe Loyola (Pisa) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
52' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) has a goal ruled out for offside!
51' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) replaces Stefano Moreo.
51' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Samuele Angori (Pisa) for his blatant foul.

48' 3 - 0 Goal! Martin Baturina (Como) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Nicolas Andrade had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:0.
47' Samuele Angori (Pisa) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
46' Surely that's handball by one of the Como players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

46' Felipe Loyola (Pisa) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Pisa win a corner kick.
46' Oscar Hiljemark has made a change at the break. Henrik Meister has come on in place of Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa).
46' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Martin Baturina (Como) whips in a cross from the corner, but Nicolas Andrade is well positioned and punches the ball away.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Martin Baturina floats over the corner and Diego Carlos (Como) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
44' Martin Baturina (Como) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

44' Nicolas Andrade makes a brilliant save! Assane Diao (Como) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper! The referee blows his whistle, Como are awarded a corner kick.

43' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
42' Assane Diao (Como) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
41' Samuele Angori (Pisa) sends a cross into the box, but Jean Butez comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jesus Rodriguez suffers an injury and Martin Baturina (Como) comes on.
35' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

34' Nico Paz (Como) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
34' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
32' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:2. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:0.
29' 2 - 0 Goal! Assane Diao plays a pass to the feet of Anastasios Douvikas (Como), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 2:0.
28' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
25' Samuele Angori (Pisa) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
23' Assane Diao (Como) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Pisa will take a throw-in.
23' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
20' Como are seeing far more of the ball now.
18' Assane Diao (Como) swings it in and Marc Oliver Kempf gets on the end of it, but Nicolas Andrade shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
18' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
17' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Como.
16' 77:23 – the latest ball possession ratio.
16' Nicolas Andrade comes off his line to intercept the corner from Jesus Rodriguez (Como).
15' Alberto Moreno (Como) sends a long ball forward to Jesus Rodriguez, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
14' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
10' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
10' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
9' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
8' Felipe Loyola (Pisa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals. It's a free kick to Como, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
7' 1 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Assane Diao (Como) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:0.
6' Assane Diao (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nicolas Andrade intercepts the ball.
5' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
3' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nicolas Andrade, who smothers the ball.
2' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
2' Felipe Loyola (Pisa) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto is the one to supervise the game today.
